summary.success_definition: At least one tested cut has Native FPS >= (1-tolerance/100)*the best measured Native FPS in the same group and view.
summary.exact_random_probability: 1 - C(n-m,k)/C(n,k), where m is the number of acceptable candidates; sampled without replacement.
summary.deterministic_interpretation: Observed coverage across these fixed model/device groups, not a statistical estimate of future-model success probability.
summary.average_random_interpretation: Exact random success probability averaged equally over these finite groups; every_group_probability uses the worst group instead.
summary.actual_budget: k_effective=min(max_native_trials,n). Counts evaluated Native trials only, not failed compilations or graph-universe candidates.
summary.additional_costs: Generic acquisition, frozen calibration training, quality evaluation and compilation are additional and excluded.
summary.calibrated_scope: Published frozen eligible-classifier predictions only. No fitting or extrapolation.
summary.tie_handling: Ascending configuration identity after byte size or descending predicted/measured FPS. No future-outcome tie breaking.
summary.validation: All success curves complete, bounded, monotone, and equal to one at exhaustive measurement. Random k=1 equals m/n.
